reply.text: {"say":"Chest day it is: heavy barbell bench first, then an incline dumbbell press, a machine press and two fly variations to finish.","title":"Chest Day","days":[{"name":"Chest Day","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-bench-press","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":8,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Touch mid-chest, drive feet into the floor.\u00a0"},{"key":"dumbbell-incline-bench-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"30-degree incline, elbows slightly tucked."},{"key":"machine-chest-press","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Slow lowering, full stretch at the bottom."},{"key":"low-to-high-cable-fly","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Sweep up to chin height, squeeze."},{"key":"pec-deck-fly","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause one second with hands together."}]}],"unmet":["I can't write weights in the notes; the app fills in weights from your own previous lifts."]}
